jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

• 
Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

• 
Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

• 
Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

• 
Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

• 
Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

• 
Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

• 
Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting

Required Qualifications
• 
Master's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

• 
Minimum 3 years of metallurgical laboratory experience, including leading failure analysis investigations (academic and/or industrial/commercial)

• 
Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills suitable for all organizational levels

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• 
Strong computer proficiency and comfort working in a high-volume environment

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead projects and manage priorities

• 
Fluency in English

• 
Pro-active behavior and professional reporting to customers

• 
Excellent problem-solving capability

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Hands-on experience with tools and instrumentation such as: digital photography, saws/cut-off wheels, cleaning equipment, hardness testing, metallographic microscopes, SEM-EDXA, stereomicroscopes, micrometers, sample preparation equipment, and related hand tools

• 
Experience using LabWare LIMS

• 
Knowledge of industrial water treatment processes and experience performing failure analyses tied to industrial water or process systems

• 
General programming knowledge

jobs.description:

• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

JOB FOCUS 
 
  The incumbent is responsible for the processes on archiving completeness and transport document compliance for documents related to Global Logistics shipments. The incumbent drives process automation and process outsourcing to ensure timely and correct execution of compliance and completeness checks of transport documents. 
 
  The incumbent orchestrates and coordinates activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders to recover missing documentation and/or correct any issues identified. Stakeholder forums are set up and driven by the incumbent to focus on issue resolution and Continuous Improvement in the space of archiving completeness and documentation compliance. Leveraging digital tools and new technologies are focus areas. 
 
  Partnership is fostered with key cross-functional stakeholders impacted by or contributing to the processes in scope of the role (including amongst other Indirect Tax, Digital, Quality, Transportation, outsourced services partner and external transport service providers). 
 
  Additionally, the incumbent must ensure that the proper activities are implemented and managed in accordance with the EU GDP/GMP requirements and/or local legislation requirements (e.g. FDA, Japanese, HPRA, etc). 
 
  JOB SUMMARY - MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY / ACCOUNTABILITIES

•   Responsible for timely archiving completeness of commercial documents, transport documents and customs documents in OpenText for GL scope of activities    
•   Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality Compliance requirements    
•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the archiving process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on archiving activities    
•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders in ensuring archiving completeness    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
•   Establishes and runs processes ensuring correctness of archived documentation    
  2) Transport documentation compliance 
   
•   Designs and orchestrates the process for conducting compliance checks of transport documents    
•   Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality compliance requirements    
•   Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on transport document compliance checks    
•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies    
•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the transport document compliance checks process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders to ensure completeness and full compliance    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
  3) Stakeholder Management 
   
•   Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience    
•   Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.    
•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit    
•   Computer skills: Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is a plus.    
  COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES 
   
•   Analytical and problem solving skills    
•   Pro-active mindset on problem solving and gap assessment    
•   Affinity with establishing structure, documentation management and compliance principles    
•   Proven track record driving positive change in a complex environment    
•   Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills based on facts, data and understanding of the regulatory requirement in complex and evolving environments; must be able to apply sound risk management    
•   Ability to prioritize, quickly synthesize information and apply regulatory requirements to a variety of scenarios    
•   Must exercise excellent judgement, make decisions based on a clear understanding of the regulatory framework, deploying strategies to conduct compliant business    
•   Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills    
•   Good communication skills and relationship builder with internal and external stakeholders

• Guide clients during the complete process of a project (follow up from A till Z),  
• Assist clients with tax audits and tax claims,  
• Handle compliance services for individuals (also expatriates):salary splits, expat calculations,…  
• Prepare resident and non-resident income tax returns  
• Assist international companies with HR matters: employment, labour contracts, optimisation of salary packages etc.,   
• Provide clients with clear (written) advice by conducting research and making the necessary calculations,  
• Be in direct contact with clients, colleagues abroad and other partner organizations. 
  
• Master s degree in (Applied) Economic Sciences or Commercial Sciences or a degree in Law, or a degree in business management  
• A tax degree is a plus,  
• Specialization in Personal income tax for expats or salary split,  
• Fluent in Dutch/Flemish, English and French,  
• Ability to work autonomously and work as a team player with excellent project management skills,  
• Flexible, accurate and eager to learn,  
• Good communication and organizational skills,  
• Proactive and hands on mentality,  
• Adherence to the highest degree of professional standards and strict client confidentiality.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales – English + Eastern European Languages
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning commercial opportunities into successful sales? Are you motivated by achieving targets and building long-term customer relationships?
 

Then this opportunity might be the perfect fit for you!
 

As an 
Inside Sales Representative, your main focus will be on managing an existing customer portfolio, reactivating former customers, and following up on warm leads who have already shown interest in the platform or available vehicles.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

Manage and develop an existing portfolio of B2B customers.
  

•  

Reconnect with former customers and identify opportunities to reactivate commercial relationships.
  

•  

Follow up on warm leads who have already expressed interest in the platform or available vehicles.
  

•  

Maintain regular contact with customers by phone and digital communication channels.
  

•  

Understand customer needs and advise them on suitable vehicles.
  

•  

Convert commercial opportunities into sales and actively work towards individual and team targets.
  

•  

Prepare quotations, manage contracts, and ensure accurate follow-up of sales activities.
  

•  

Collaborate closely with the sales team to improve customer satisfaction and commercial performance.
  
 

•  

You have previous experience in sales or a commercially oriented position.
  

•  

You are genuinely passionate about sales and motivated by achieving results.
  

•  

You enjoy convincing customers, closing deals, and reaching commercial targets.
  

•  

You have an interest in the automotive industry or are eager to learn more about it.
  

•  

You are fluent in English and at least one Eastern European language.
  

•  

You are confident, persuasive, proactive, and not afraid to take initiative.
  

•  

You have strong communication skills and enjoy building customer relationships.
  

•  

You work in a structured and accurate manner.
  

•  

You are a team player who can also work independently.

Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
